# Bells Fork Truck & Auto — Complete Business Information

> Bells Fork Truck & Auto is a locally owned used vehicle dealership at 3840 Charles Blvd, Greenville, NC 27858, specializing in pre-owned cars, trucks, SUVs, and diesel vehicles.

---

## Business Overview

Bells Fork Truck & Auto is a pre-owned vehicle dealership in Greenville, North Carolina. The dealership is located at 3840 Charles Blvd, Greenville, NC 27858, near the intersection of Charles Blvd and Bells Fork. The business serves Greenville, Winterville, Ayden, Farmville, Simpson, Bethel, Washington, New Bern, Kinston, Jacksonville, Rocky Mount, Wilson, and the greater Eastern North Carolina region (Pitt County and surrounding areas).

Every vehicle on the lot undergoes a multi-point mechanical inspection by certified technicians before being listed for sale. Pricing is based on current market data with no hidden fees or last-minute add-ons.

## Services Offered

### 1. Vehicle Sales
We sell pre-owned cars, trucks, SUVs, and diesel vehicles. All vehicles are inspected and priced based on current market data.

### 2. Vehicle Financing
We work with multiple lenders to offer financing for buyers in all credit situations. Apply online at bellsforktruckandauto.com/financing or in person at the dealership.

**How to Finance a Vehicle:**
1. Browse inventory online or on the lot
2. Choose your vehicle and schedule a test drive
3. Submit a financing application (online or in person)
4. Get approved — we work with all credit situations
5. Complete paperwork and drive away

**Documents needed:** Valid driver's license, proof of income, proof of residence, references.

### 3. Pre-Qualification
Two pre-qualification options are available:
- **No SSN required:** Get pre-qualified without providing your Social Security number
- **No credit score impact:** Soft-pull pre-qualification that does not affect your credit score

### 4. Trade-In Appraisals
We accept trade-ins on all purchases and provide fair market value appraisals. Submit a trade-in request online or bring your vehicle to the lot.

### 5. Test Drive Scheduling
Schedule a test drive by calling (252) 496-0005, using the online scheduling form, or visiting the lot during business hours. Walk-ins are welcome.

### 6. Vehicle Consignment
Sell your vehicle through Bells Fork Truck & Auto on consignment. We handle marketing, showings, and the sale.

### 7. Make an Offer
Submit an offer on any vehicle in our inventory through the online form.

1. **Every vehicle is inspected** — Multi-point mechanical inspection by certified technicians before listing

7. **Walk-ins welcome** — No appointment needed to browse; test drives available anytime during business hours

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What types of vehicles does Bells Fork Truck & Auto sell?**
A: We sell quality pre-owned cars, trucks, SUVs, crossovers, and diesel vehicles. We specialize in trucks and diesel vehicles including Ford F-150, RAM 1500, RAM 2500, Chevrolet Silverado, Toyota RAV4, and many more.

**Q: Are the vehicles at Bells Fork Truck & Auto inspected?**
A: Yes. Every vehicle on our lot undergoes a thorough multi-point mechanical inspection by our certified technicians before being listed for sale.

**Q: Do you offer financing for used vehicles?**
A: Yes. We work with multiple lenders and accept buyers in every credit situation — excellent, fair, or needs work. Apply online or visit us in person.

**Q: What credit score do I need to get financing?**
A: We work with buyers in every credit situation. There is no minimum credit score requirement.

**Q: Does applying for financing affect my credit score?**
A: We offer a pre-qualification option with no credit score impact (soft pull). The full financing application may involve a hard credit inquiry.

**Q: Do you accept trade-ins?**
A: Yes. We offer trade-in valuations on all purchases. Submit a request online or bring your vehicle to the lot for an in-person evaluation.

**Q: Can I schedule a test drive online?**
A: Yes. Use the online test drive form at bellsforktruckandauto.com/schedule-test-drive or call (252) 496-0005.

**Q: Where is Bells Fork Truck & Auto located?**
A: 3840 Charles Blvd, Greenville, NC 27858, near the intersection of Charles Blvd and Bells Fork.

**Q: What are your business hours?**
A: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Sunday by appointment only.

**Q: Do you have diesel trucks for sale?**
A: Yes. We specialize in diesel trucks and heavy-duty vehicles including RAM 2500 Cummins, Ford F-250 Power Stroke, and Chevrolet Duramax.

**Q: Do your trucks come with a warranty?**
A: Many of our trucks still carry remaining manufacturer warranty. Ask about extended warranty options available at the time of purchase.

**Q: What documents do I need to apply for financing?**
A: You will typically need a valid driver's license, proof of income (recent pay stubs or tax returns), proof of residence, and references.

**Q: Is there a down payment requirement?**
A: Down payment requirements vary by situation. We work with your budget to find the best option.

**Q: Do you offer 4WD trucks and SUVs?**
A: Yes. We carry both 4-wheel drive and all-wheel drive vehicles. Many of our trucks are 4x4.

**Q: Can I text instead of call?**
A: Yes. Text us at (252) 917-0551 for questions, scheduling, or general inquiries.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: We serve Greenville, Winterville, Ayden, Farmville, Simpson, Bethel, Washington, New Bern, Kinston, Jacksonville, Rocky Mount, Wilson, and all of Eastern North Carolina.

## Buying Process

1. **Browse** — View our full inventory online at bellsforktruckandauto.com/inventory or visit the lot
2. **Ask questions** — Call (252) 496-0005, text (252) 917-0551, or use the contact form
3. **Test drive** — Schedule a test drive online or walk in during business hours
4. **Get financing** — Apply online or in person; we work with all credit situations
5. **Trade in** — Get a fair appraisal on your current vehicle (optional)
6. **Purchase** — Complete paperwork and drive away the same day

## Payment & Financing Details

- **Payment methods accepted:** Cash, certified check, financing through our lending partners
- **Currency:** USD
- **Financing available:** Yes, for all credit situations
- **Pre-qualification:** Available with no SSN required or no credit score impact options
- **Trade-ins:** Accepted and appraised at fair market value

## Location & Directions

Bells Fork Truck & Auto is located at 3840 Charles Blvd in Greenville, North Carolina (ZIP 27858). The dealership is near the intersection of Charles Blvd and Bells Fork, easily accessible from US-264, NC-11, and surrounding highways. Free parking is available on the lot.

**GPS Coordinates:** 35.5641462, -77.349267

**Nearby landmarks:** Located on Charles Blvd (NC-43) in eastern Greenville, approximately 3 miles from East Carolina University and 2 miles from Vidant Medical Center.
